scope: Independent reconstruction of the predeclared thirty within-role chronological-first/second A/A intervals only. No candidate-versus-competitor contrasts, formal performance claim or F64 admission.

independent_raw.raw_chain_format: SHA256(initial ASCII Q32-INDEPENDENT-NATIVE-RECEIPT-SCHEDULE-ORDER-v1 plus NUL; for each frozen native job: uint64be len(jobid),jobid ASCII,uint64be len(raw native),raw native,uint64be len(raw receipt),raw receipt)
independent_raw.numerical_method: 90-decimal-digit odd-df Student tail via t=sqrt(31)*tan(theta), cos^30 tail-integral recurrence, Machin pi, atan series and 230-step bisection; input probability is the exact binary64 original 1-.05/60. No original project module imported.

policy.zero_policy: Preserve zero/undefined positions; do not delete rows or add epsilon; undefined prevents qualification. No measured AA zero occurred.
policy.direction: Within each role and block, chronological first job ID divided by chronological second job ID, independent of A/B label.
policy.derived_metrics: Sum the two integer read phases before each ratio; verify integer eight-phase total equals native total before inference.
policy.unit: Six frozen block log ratios are averaged per macrocycle; the 32 macrocycle means, never children or blocks as independent units, enter df31 Student-t inference.
policy.coverage: Separate nominal model-conditional simultaneous 95% A/A family under the retained approximately normal independent macrocycle model; no unconditional or distribution-free coverage claim.
